articles.summary: LITTLE ROCK, Ark., Sept. 18, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Dillard’s, Inc. (NYSE: DDS) (the “Company” or “Dillard’s”), a Texas corporation headquartered in Little Rock, Arkansas, today announced that it will voluntarily transfer the primary listings of its securities from the New York Stock Exchange
articles.title: Dillard’s, Inc. to Transfer U.S. Stock Exchange Listings to the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE)
